WITH june_bills AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT bill_id
  FROM store.pos_lines
  WHERE bill_ts >= '2026-06-01' AND bill_ts < '2026-07-01'
),
bill_payments AS (
  SELECT pp.bill_id,
         MAX(CASE WHEN pp.till_status = 'approved' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_approved
  FROM payments.pos_payments pp
  JOIN june_bills jb ON pp.bill_id = jb.bill_id
  GROUP BY pp.bill_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cancelled_before_payment
FROM june_bills jb
LEFT JOIN bill_payments bp ON jb.bill_id = bp.bill_id
WHERE bp.has_approved IS NULL OR bp.has_approved = 0;

WITH june_bills AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT bill_id
  FROM store.pos_lines
  WHERE bill_ts >= '2026-06-01' AND bill_ts < '2026-07-01'
),
bill_payment_details AS (
  SELECT pp.bill_id,
         pp.attempt,
         pp.till_status,
         pp.tender,
         pp.ts
  FROM payments.pos_payments pp
  JOIN june_bills jb ON pp.bill_id = jb.bill_id
)
SELECT bill_id, attempt, till_status, tender, ts
FROM bill_payment_details
ORDER BY bill_id, attempt;

WITH june_bills AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT bill_id
  FROM store.pos_lines
  WHERE bill_ts >= '2026-06-01' AND bill_ts < '2026-07-01'
),
bill_payment_status AS (
  SELECT pp.bill_id,
         MAX(CASE WHEN pp.till_status = 'approved' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_approved,
         COUNT(*) AS total_attempts,
         MAX(CASE WHEN pp.till_status IN ('declined', 'failed', 'failed: no response') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_failed
  FROM payments.pos_payments pp
  JOIN june_bills jb ON pp.bill_id = jb.bill_id
  GROUP BY pp.bill_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS bills_with_no_approved_payment
FROM june_bills jb
LEFT JOIN bill_payment_status bps ON jb.bill_id = bps.bill_id
WHERE bps.has_approved IS NULL OR bps.has_approved = 0;

WITH june_upi_payments AS (
  SELECT pp.bill_id, pp.attempt, pp.till_status, pp.rrn, pp.ts
  FROM payments.pos_payments pp
  JOIN store.pos_lines pl ON pp.bill_id = pl.bill_id
  WHERE pp.tender = 'UPI'
    AND pl.bill_ts >= '2026-06-01' AND pl.bill_ts < '2026-07-01'
),
upi_report_june AS (
  SELECT rrn, status, status_ts, bill_ref
  FROM payments.psp_upi_report
  WHERE initiated_ts >= '2026-06-01' AND initiated_ts < '2026-07-01'
)
SELECT jup.bill_id, jup.attempt, jup.till_status, jup.rrn, jup.ts,
       ur.status AS upi_final_status, ur.status_ts
FROM june_upi_payments jup
LEFT JOIN upi_report_june ur ON jup.rrn = ur.rrn
WHERE jup.till_status IN ('declined', 'failed', 'failed: no response')
ORDER BY jup.ts;
